prespecification_note: Written and checksum-pinned before the model was evaluated at the MMY-3021 sampling times. Not blinded: the MMY-3021 Table 1 values were read before writing this plan, and from 3.0h it was known that the model's emulated day 11 AUClast on the CAN-1004 schedule is 127 ng.h/mL. Before writing, the planner noted that this figure lies near the lower end of the interval implied by the MMY-3021 mean and SD, so the result is expected to be borderline and may depend on the sampling schedule and AUC rule. No value on the MMY-3021 schedule had been computed.
not_this: Not validation or qualification of the PK model; no acceptance limits are introduced.
Not a comparison of individual concentrations; only Table 1 means and SDs are available.
Not a re-fit: no parameter is estimated or tuned.
Not a dosing or exposure prediction for any patient.
Does not test the day 1 to day 11 rise: MMY-3021 sampled day 11 only.
question: Is the constant-clearance model's day 11 exposure consistent with a second, independent IV study with 72 h sampling (MMY-3021 PK substudy, n = 14), given that CAN-1004 found day 11 under-predicted (3.0h) and Ogawa 2008 found it consistent (3.0f)?

data.model: intelligence_store/bortezomib_pk.py (exact three-compartment solution; Lignet 2022 Table 1 per-m2 parameters), unchanged from 3.0f and 3.0h

simulation.regimen: IV bolus 1.3 mg/m2 at t = 0, 72, 168 and 240 h; no drug before t = 0.
simulation.body_size: Not needed: dose and parameters are per m2.
simulation.day11_profile: Model concentration at each MMY-3021 sampling time after t = 240 h, including drug remaining from the doses on days 1, 4 and 8.

nca_emulation.method: Same function as 3.0f and 3.0h (bortezomib_pk_ogawa_check.nca): C0 by log-linear back-extrapolation from the 2 and 5 min samples; AUC to the last sample (72 h) by trapezoids from (0, C0).

sensitivity.note: the same profile sampled without the 32 h point, to show the effect of the schedule

secondary.name: cmax_day11
secondary.emulation: highest model concentration among the sampled times (the observed median tmax is the 2 min sample)

descriptive: The model's day 11 result against Ogawa 2008 (3.0f), CAN-1004 (3.0h) and MMY-3021, side by side.
Ratio of the two observed IV day 11 means in the same publication: CAN-1004 241 / MMY-3021 151 (no interval; different studies).

comparison.interval: 95% confidence interval of the observed mean: mean +/- t(0.975, 13) x SD / sqrt(14), t = 2.1604.
comparison.robustness: Each classified endpoint under every reading; robust if all agree.

decision_rule.summary: The model is recorded as consistent with MMY-3021 day 11 exposure if the primary endpoint is consistent under the primary reading. If consistent, the CAN-1004 day 11 under-prediction is recorded as not reproduced in a second independent study, and day 11 evidence across the three studies is recorded as mixed; if under-predicted, it is recorded as reproduced. Either way the day 1 findings and the rise finding (Ogawa, CAN-1004) are unchanged, and the model's status is not upgraded: it still disagrees with both studies that sampled day 1.
decision_rule.what_changes: Evidence status gains a further report on the bortezomib PK component's outside-data layer. No model, page or platelet result changes.

known_differences: Model AUClast runs to 72 h; observed AUClast runs to the last quantifiable sample, which may be earlier for some patients (assay limit not stated). This biases the observed mean low relative to a 72 h AUC, against the model's favour if anything is borderline.
MMY-3021 population: relapsed myeloma after 1-3 prior therapies, multinational; the model's parameters are scaled from pediatric data.
Cycle 1 day 11 only; dexamethasone could be added from cycle 5 and does not affect cycle 1.
